ConfigError.to_dict() returns exactly `{"error":"invalid_config","issues":[{"path":...,"code":...}]}`. CLI adds `--dry-run`, prints v2 JSON, and returns 2 with the ConfigError dict on stderr without touching files. migrate_file and service.export_config preserve source bytes / never mutate source.

R3 (verification): Exact acceptance command passed per trusted runtime output, and the agent reported the actual result.

Dry-run and no-write-on-error guarantees are enforced structurally because migrate_file calls load() (which validates) before save(), so an invalid config raises before any destination write; tests assert byte-preservation and non-existence of new destinations. The reported remaining limitations (a leftover scratch file, sys.path invocation detail, undefined container-path judgment call, missing packaging metadata) are accurate and non-blocking. No missing user-named sub-requirement found.
